lines.beaver: 준호 씨, 우리 습관 같이 고치기로 했죠?
lines.beaver_en: Junho, we agreed to fix our habits together, right?
lines.beaver_roman: Junho ssi, uri seupgwan gachi gochigiro haetjyo?
lines.learner: 네, 저는 낮잠 자는 버릇을 고치고 싶어요.
lines.en: Yes, I want to break my napping habit.
lines.roman: Ne, jeoneun natjam janeun beoreuseul gochigo sipeoyo.

lines.learner: 오후마다 두 시간쯤 자요. 너무 심해요.
lines.en: About two hours every afternoon. It's too much.
lines.roman: Ohumada du siganjjeum jayo. Neomu simhaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: So you can't sleep well at night?
lines.learner: 네, 늦게 자서 아침에 못 일어나요.
lines.en: Yes, I sleep late, so I can't get up in the morning.
lines.roman: Ne, neutge jaseo achime mot ireonayo.

lines.beaver_en: How about getting up early every morning?
lines.en: Okay. I'll get up at seven.

lines.beaver_en: Do you doze off in class too?
lines.en: Yes, no matter how hard I try, I often doze off.

lines.beaver_en: Do you dream a lot, too?
lines.en: Yes, I have strange dreams every night.

lines.beaver_en: What do you do before going out?
lines.learner: 양치질하고 머리를 감아요. 시간이 오래 걸려요.
lines.en: I brush my teeth and wash my hair. It takes a long time.
lines.roman: Yangchijilhago meorireul gamayo. Sigani orae geollyeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: When do you take a bath?
lines.learner: 저녁마다 목욕해요. 아침엔 따로 안 해요.
lines.en: Every evening. I don't do it separately in the morning.
lines.roman: Jeonyeongmada mogyokaeyo. Achimen ttaro an haeyo.

lines.beaver: 저는 자기 전에 휴대폰을 오래 봐요.
lines.beaver_en: I look at my phone for a long time before bed.
lines.beaver_roman: Jeoneun jagi jeone hyudaeponeul orae bwayo.
lines.learner: 그럼 자기 전에 안 보는 게 어때요?
lines.en: Then how about not looking at it before bed?
lines.roman: Geureom jagi jeone an boneun ge eottaeyo?

lines.beaver_en: Good. Let's start together from tomorrow!
lines.en: Yes, let's decide to build good habits!
